verdict.rationale: Lorikeet documents escalation to a human with full interaction history so the team 'picks up mid-conversation', and a human agent stepping in inside the same platform. That covers the full-conversation and no-repeat core of the story. However, the history claim comes only from an industry page, and nothing documents an AI-generated summary or structured collected details. Missing for 10: handoff summary, structured collected-details transfer, general product docs on the handoff payload, independent/hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, when the agent escalates, the human gets the full conversation, a summary, and collected details — the customer never repeats themselves

citations.quote: When a case requires a specialist or regulatory review, it escalates with full interaction history so your team picks up mid-conversation.
When the AI concierge can't resolve a conversation, a human agent steps in directly inside the same platform
